quests.question: Instead of paper tickets, the concert sent a code to her phone; the ticket was _____.
quests.explanation: A code sent to a phone instead of paper is electronic, so digital fits; printed contradicts.

quests.question: Tapping the screen did nothing, and even the power button had no effect; the phone was _____.
quests.explanation: Tapping the screen and pressing the power button with no result mean no reaction: unresponsive.

quests.question: No cables or plugs were needed; the headphones were _____.
quests.explanation: 'No cables or plugs' means the headphones connect without wires, so wireless fits.

quests.question: The script was broken, so she had to enter every figure by hand, working _____.
quests.explanation: Entering every figure by hand after the script broke means doing it manually; automatically contradicts it.

quests.question: Given the same input, the program always gives exactly the same output, never varying; it is _____.
quests.explanation: Always producing exactly the same output from the same input is what deterministic means.

quests.question: The invoices are generated and sent each month without anyone touching them; the process is _____.
quests.explanation: Invoices generated and sent with nobody touching them means machines do the work: automated.

quests.question: The tools can exchange data and work together, whichever company made them; they are _____.
quests.explanation: Tools that exchange data and work together, whichever company made them, are interoperable; isolated contradicts.

quests.question: The software needed twelve clicks for a simple task and crashed on each; the interface was _____.
quests.explanation: Twelve clicks for a simple task and crashes show awkward, heavy design, so clunky fits.

quests.question: The virus lay hidden and caused no symptoms until years later; its infection stayed _____ for a decade.
quests.explanation: Lying hidden and causing no symptoms for years means present but not showing: latent.

quests.question: The tip was sent with no name or address, so the sender reported _____.
quests.explanation: A tip with no name or address hides the sender's identity, so anonymously fits; openly and publicly contradict.

quests.question: I tapped 'send' and the message appeared on his screen at the same moment, arriving _____.
quests.explanation: A message appearing the very moment it is sent arrives without delay: instantly.

quests.question: Rather than a perfect formula, the app uses a rule of thumb that usually finds good answers fast; it is _____.
quests.explanation: A rule of thumb that usually works but isn't guaranteed describes a heuristic method.

quests.question: Grandma set up the tablet herself with no help, since the menus were so simple; the design is _____.
quests.explanation: Setting up a tablet alone thanks to simple menus shows easy use, so user-friendly fits.

quests.question: The speaker fits in a bag, weighs 300 g and runs on a battery; it is highly _____.
quests.explanation: Fitting in a bag, weighing 300 g and running on a battery make it easy to carry: portable.

quests.question: The photo was out of focus, with soft outlines and no sharp detail; it looked _____.
quests.explanation: Out of focus, soft outlines and no sharp detail describe an unclear image: blurry.

quests.question: The whole system is one giant block of code, so changing one part means redeploying everything; it is _____.
quests.explanation: One giant block that must be redeployed as a whole is monolithic; modular contradicts.

quests.question: The engineer fixed the server from her home without visiting the office, working _____.
quests.explanation: Fixing a server from home without visiting the office means working from a distance: remotely.

quests.question: The server handled a million visitors without crashing; the system proved _____.
quests.explanation: Handling a million visitors without crashing shows strength under pressure, so robust fits.

quests.question: One litre of petrol is exactly the same as any other and can be swapped freely; it is _____.
quests.explanation: Every litre is identical and freely swappable, which is what fungible means; unique contradicts.

quests.question: With strong passwords and two-step login, the files were stored _____.
quests.explanation: Strong passwords and two-step login protect the files, so securely fits; carelessly contradicts.

quests.question: She joined the video call from her sofa with a stable connection; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Joining a video call over a stable connection means being connected to the internet: online.

quests.question: I clicked and typed but nothing moved on the screen; the computer was _____.
quests.explanation: Clicking and typing with no screen movement shows the computer had stopped working: frozen.

quests.question: The wifi dropped and the page wouldn't load; the laptop was _____.
quests.explanation: A dropped wifi signal and a page that won't load mean no internet, so offline fits.

quests.question: Only one company owns the code and no one else may copy it; the software is _____.
quests.explanation: One company owning the code and banning copies means exclusive ownership: proprietary.

quests.question: Scrambled so that only the recipient's key can read it, the message was _____.
quests.explanation: Scrambled so that only the recipient's key can unlock it, the message is encrypted; plain and public contradict.

quests.question: In the chat, replies can come hours later, with no need for everyone to be online at once; it is _____.
quests.explanation: Replies hours later with nobody needing to be online together means not in step: asynchronous.

quests.question: The page took two full minutes to load, and the progress bar crawled; the connection was _____.
quests.explanation: Two minutes to load and a crawling progress bar show poor speed, so slow fits; fast contradicts.

quests.question: Every update brought new crashes and error pop-ups; the app was _____.
quests.explanation: New crashes and error pop-ups with every update show faulty software, so buggy fits; stable contradicts.

quests.question: The report broke sales down by hour, product and shop, giving very _____ detail.
quests.explanation: Breaking sales down by hour, product and shop gives fine-grained detail: granular.

quests.question: The game froze, flickered and restarted at random; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Freezing, flickering and random restarts show frequent faults, so glitchy fits; smooth contradicts.
